profile.name: m6000x2-64g
profile.title: Two Quadro M6000 24 GB with 64 GB of RAM
profile.tested: 2026-11-25 under StartOS (T5810, E5-2699 v3, NVMe): speed 46.2 / 58.8 / 33.1 / 46.7 tok/s (one card: 42.3 / 46.5 / 33.2 / 38.1), balanced 40.3 / 48.2 / 29.4 / 43.1 (39.6 / 40.6 / 29.5 / 34.8), quality 39.9 / 47.7 / 29.3 / 39.8 (35.8 / 38.8 / 29.2 / 34.5) (chat / code / story / 4K doc); quality reads 48K prompts at 310 tok/s (one card: 184); answer checks passed
notes: Both cards run Strata's layer split (about half the layers each, with their own expert cache and attention cache) and --pipeline-windows 2, which starts the next step on the first card while the second checks the drafts. Direct copies between the cards are not needed (on the test machine they did not work); the cards hand over through RAM.
